title: Inpainting masks and edge blending
hook: The sampler sees your mask on a grid eight times coarser than the picture: where a 3-pixel line vanishes, what grow and feather really do, and how the per-step blend works.

verified.claim: KSamplerX0Inpaint applies the blend at every step.

reshape_mask resizes bilinear with no antialias, so a cell reads the 4th and 5th of its 8 pixels. The new browser lab uses that rule, and it gave the lab's 0, 0.5, 1, 1, 0.5, 0, 0, 0 for a 3-pixel stripe.
VAEEncodeForInpaint rounds, grows and greys. Its growth is off-centre at even sizes.
FeatherMask and ImagePadForOutpaint ramps, and the other tables, come from the lab.

unchecked: The lab uses a stand-in model, so it says nothing about how a seam looks in a real image: see What is contested.
We do not say ComfyUI's blend is RePaint. The mechanism is of the same kind, and the code does not cite it.
